item.description: - Prevents KeyHop from asking for Accessibility access again after an update when access is already enabled. - Keeps onboarding text readable and in sync with the current light or dark appearance. - Matches the updater icon to the current appearance and polishes the Updates controls.

KeyHop 260904.1 makes setup and configuration cleaner and more consistent.
- Assign apps from a compact keyboard strip that keeps every slot neatly aligned. - Recognize home-row positions more easily with keycap-style labels and F/J markers. - Use the same Leader-key and app-assignment controls in onboarding and Settings. - Follow a simpler Accessibility permission step with clearer, more readable guidance. - Enjoy more consistent spacing, alignment, and status presentation throughout Settings.

KeyHop’s first release makes everyday app switching immediate and predictable.
- Double-tap your chosen modifier, then press a home-row key to jump directly to an assigned app. - Assign up to ten apps and keep their positions consistent across supported keyboard layouts. - Follow a guided first-run experience with clearer Accessibility permission recovery. - Use the new app icon and pixel-sharp menu bar symbol, with matching balanced spacing. - Pause KeyHop, resume it, or launch it automatically when you sign in.
